versions.title: Gateway Resilience Page, GCash Callback Logging, and UI Enhancement

newFeatures.text: Added a payment gateway downtime/maintenance landing page that automatically displays when the checkout provider is unreachable or experiencing issues
Implemented GCash callback logging system to capture NOTIFICATION responses and store transaction data for audit and monitoring
Created GcashNotificationLogs table in SOS_OIAMS database with fields: TransactionID, Status, AccountNo, AssessmentNo, PaymentGateway, DateTimeReceived, Payload, StatusInGcash, CallbackTriggerByGcash
Enhanced payment confirmation page with a modern, responsive UI design for better user experience across devices

improvements.text: Improved user clarity by distinguishing system errors from payment gateway issues during transaction failures
Improved audit and traceability of payment transactions through structured GCash callback logging
Improved payment confirmation flow with a more modern and responsive interface design

fixes: Fixed misleading failure messages when the issue originates from the payment gateway rather than the system

versions.title: Initial Release of Universal Checkout API Integration

newFeatures.text: Implemented Universal Checkout API to centralize payment processing across multiple services
Integrated primary payment gateway for online transactions
Enabled basic checkout flow from system modules to payment gateway

improvements.text: Streamlined payment integration by centralizing checkout logic into a single API layer
